subject: Conditional discount & evidence required for commit pricing
messages:
From: Lillian Park <lillian.park@acme.ai>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
Cc: procure@acme.ai
Date: Tue, 28 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Pricing and compliance gating for a commit

Hi Vanessa,

Thanks for the product overview yesterday. Acme is evaluating a hosted inference contract and we're looking at a usage-based commit model (per-token). Before we can sign a multiyear commit we need a clear picture on:

- Tiered per-token pricing for 50M / 200M / 1B tokens/month
- Whether discounts are contingent on a signed DPA and SOC2 Type II evidence (we need to confirm this with our InfoSec)
- Timeline to get SOC2 artifacts and any interim attestation you can provide

Do you have a pricing sheet you can share and a standard approach when customers require compliance evidence before commit pricing is activated? Our procurement deadline to include pricing in the PO is 2026-08-20.

Appreciate any detail you can share.

Best,
Lillian Park
Sr. Procurement Manager, Acme AI
Lillian.Park@acme.ai

Attachment: (none)

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Lillian Park <lillian.park@acme.ai>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 29 Jul 2026 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pricing and compliance gating for a commit

Hi Lillian —

Thanks — glad yesterday's demo was helpful. I'll loop Rishi (pricing) for the exact tiered rates, and we can also put together the SOC2/dpa materials. Quick answers up front:

- We publish per-token pricing with committed discounts for volume tiers; I will share a proposal.
- Our standard commercial approach is that committed discount rates are conditional on execution of our DPA; for larger commitments we typically request SOC2 Type II evidence or an SOC2 report review before finalizing the discounted rates.
- If timing is tight, we can provide a SOC2 summary and a portal link while the formal evidence is prepared — sometimes we offer a short provisional period where customers can invoice at list pricing until we confirm compliance artifacts.

I'll let Rishi share numbers and a recommended path given Acme's timelines. If you prefer, we can do a 30-minute call next week to align procurement and security expectations.

Thanks,
Vanessa Ortiz
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com

Attachment: (none)

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Lillian Park <lillian.park@acme.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 03 Aug 2026 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pricing and compliance gating for a commit

Hi Lillian — following up with a concise proposal. See attached pricing-proposal.xlsx (pricing bands + example math). Summary here:

- Tier A (50M tokens/mo): $0.0008 per token (list) -> 10% discount with signed DPA
- Tier B (200M tokens/mo): $0.00065 per token (list) -> 18% discount with signed DPA + SOC2 Type II evidence
- Tier C (1B tokens/mo): $0.00050 per token (list) -> 25% discount with signed DPA + SOC2 Type II evidence + minimum 12-month commit

Notes on compliance gating:
- We require an executed DPA for any committed discount. For larger, enterprise-tier discounts (Tier B and C) we also request SOC2 Type II evidence (report or auditor letter) before the discounted rates are applied to invoices. That is a standard ask from legal/security.
- If Acme needs the pricing locked into a PO before SOC2 is available, we can include a conditional clause: discounted pricing is effective once we have DPA signed and SOC2 artifacts delivered within 30 days; otherwise invoices will be billed at list pricing until cleared, with retrospective credits only by exception and with approvals.

Alternatives to accelerate: provide SOC2 report from a recent period, or agree to an initial short-term trial at a smaller committed volume to bridge procurement timelines.

I've cc'd Marissa from Legal to help with DPA redlines. Let us know which tiers you're targeting and if you want the conditional clause in the quote.

Thanks,
Rishi Malhotra
Head of Sales Strategy, Redwood Inference
rishi.malhotra@redwood.com

Attachments: pricing-proposal.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)

From: Lillian Park <lillian.park@acme.ai>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
Cc: procure@acme.ai
Date: Wed, 05 Aug 2026 11:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pricing and compliance gating for a commit

Rishi / Vanessa — thanks for the clarity and the spreadsheet. Acme is likely to target Tier B (200M tokens/mo) for year 1 with option to scale. A few procurement clarifications:

- We will require a signed DPA before the PO is fully issued. SOC2 Type II is preferred; if you can provide a downloadable report or an auditor attest letter that will satisfy InfoSec.
- If SOC2 is not immediately available, we will accept an attestation + access to a vendor security portal for artifacts.
- We also need to confirm SLA credits and retention windows to align with our data policy — can someone from your security team share the standard retention/SLA doc?

Procurement timeline: we need a final quote and DPA redlines by 2026-08-18 to meet our internal cutoffs. Can you confirm whether the conditional clause you mentioned is acceptable and whether Redwood can commit to a 30-day window for delivering SOC2 artifacts after DPA execution?

Thanks,
Lillian

Attachment: (none)

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Cc: Lillian Park <lillian.park@acme.ai>, procure@acme.ai
Date: Mon, 09 Aug 2026 15:30:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Pricing and compliance gating for a commit

Marissa / Rishi — looping legal + security on the final ask from Acme. Proposed commercial path (for approval):

1) Offer Tier B list with a 18% committed discount, conditional on executed DPA + SOC2 Type II artifacts received within 30 days of DPA signature. If artifacts are not provided within 30 days, invoices bill at list pricing until artifacts are provided; retrospective credits require VP approval.

2) As a sign of good faith, offer a 30-day provisional trial at 50% of Tier B committed volume billed at list price up front, convertible to the committed plan once artifacts are received. This helps Acme start integration before formal SOC2 delivery.

3) Attachments to send to Acme now: SOC2-summary.pdf (public summary of controls) + DPA_draft_redlines.docx (our starting redlines). If Legal signs off, I'll send these to Lillian and request confirmation of timeline.

Marissa — can you confirm we can include the conditional clause and the 30-day artifact window? Also please confirm whether retrospective credits are allowed only with Exec approval. Rishi — if approved, I'll send a revised quote to Lillian today.

Thanks,
Vanessa Ortiz
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com

Attachments: SOC2-summary.pdf (application/pdf), DPA_draft_redlines.docx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document)
